Dear [Name],

Thank you for your follow‑up questions of [date]. Below are our responses addressing independent validation, the classification of Hub‑3‑reliant flows, and the conditional‑launch pathway.

1. Independent validation  
Independent validation of FC‑01 (monitoring rules) and FC‑02 (data‑mapping) will be conducted in accordance with the Validation Test Plan Outline provided with our submission. A flow will be classified as “Hub‑3‑reliant” where monitoring coverage, automated rule execution or essential feed mappings located within Regional Hub 3 are necessary for automated detection or escalation of financial crime risks for that corridor or use case. By contrast, flows that do not depend on Hub 3 for core monitoring or rule execution are classified as non‑reliant and may proceed under the Firm’s normal governance. The Corridor Mapping Spreadsheet we provided with our submission identifies the current classification for each proposed corridor/use case in accordance with those operational criteria. Corridor classifications will be reviewed periodically as routing and product design evolve, under the oversight of the Product Governance Committee – Digital Payments (PGC‑DP) and the GFCC, and any material reclassification will be reflected in our MI and reported through those governance forums.

3. Conditional launch  
We are not proposing a conditional launch in this submission. Consistent with the Authority’s closing letter, we would only consider proposing a conditional launch plan if explicitly invited by the Authority and only where FC‑01 is functionally implemented and FC‑02 mapping fixes are within controlled tolerances, supported by robust independent validation evidence.
